content_production_rate.rationale: Unchanged. S363-S365 were read-only audits — no content was produced. Throughput plateau at 7.5 items/session, 5.6 net-new/day. Label-change pipeline exhausted. S899 model proven but not sustained.

quality.rationale: FD-075 (CRITICAL) refuted — item is structurally complete. DL-021 (HIGH, 95 items) resolved and confirmed — all 100 Pack E Section C items have distractor EW. 100% structural completeness on Certified items (0/2,337 blank — was reported as 1/2,540 broken). But DL-035 (39 items), DL-031 (~500 items), DL-010, DL-009, and the catastrophic cognitive gap (5.8% vs 40% target) remain open. No CRITICAL-severity defects in Certified pool.

maturity_velocity.rationale: S362→S366 cycle demonstrates rapid risk investigation capability: two HIGH-severity risks (FD-075, DL-021) fully investigated and resolved/refuted across 3 audit sessions in <24 hours. Cross-session verification chain (S362 claim → S363 scan → S364 per-item confirmation → S366 board synthesis) demonstrates governance maturity. Documentation conflict resolved (DL-021: DEFECT_LIBRARY.md confirmed correct). Certified count drift identified (2,317→2,337). However, readiness score still stalled at 75. Defect detection still outpaces resolution for non-urgent items. DL-035, DL-031, DL-010, DL-009 have zero progress.

administration.rationale: DL-021 documentation conflict RESOLVED — single largest administrative uncertainty eliminated. FD-075 claim corrected — S362 board was operating on stale data. Certified pool count drift quantified (+20). S363/S364 reports provide authoritative ground-truth evidence for future boards. However: registry still stale (2 days, broken section categorization), baselines still have drift (Pack C certified 388→398, Pack D 389→399), CURRENT_BASELINES.md §3 DL-021 still says OPEN, 0 of 2,500 Packs A-D items carry certification_session metadata. Governance guard test suite remains 51/51 PASS.

automation.rationale: Unchanged. S365 confirmed all S362 automation findings. Governance guard is the only fully automated, self-testing component. 53.1% of scripts uncategorized. No CI/CD pipeline. Pre-delivery safety check 100% manual. Registry and baselines fully manual. DL-028 tooling regression unfixed. Path to 55 requires Phase 1 quick wins (fix registry + automate pre-delivery + automate baselines → 53) + Phase 2 structural (CI/CD + script cataloging → 56).

expansion_capacity.rationale: Unchanged. 203 archived clone slots available. 4 sections below 50% certified (Pack C EC/FC, Pack D ED/FD). Case pool fully certified. S899 model proven. No new content authored since S362.

updated_scorecard.score_context: S362 measured expansion economics with 2 CRITICAL/HIGH risks (FD-075 blank item, DL-021 documentation conflict) and a Quality score anchored at 38 due to the CRITICAL defect. S366 re-measures with both risks removed (FD-075 refuted, DL-021 resolved) — Quality improves from 38→55 (+17), Maturity from 52→58 (+6), Administration from 58→65 (+7). The 6-point overall improvement reflects the removal of the two most severe S362 findings.

binding_constraint_reassessment.s362_binding_constraint: Content design throughput — governance and infrastructure are adequate; the platform cannot produce new Analyze/Evaluate content at sufficient rate
binding_constraint_reassessment.s366_constraint_shift: The binding constraint has bifurcated. Content throughput remains the PRIMARY constraint for closing the cognitive gap and DL-031 labels (both require authoring, not mechanical fixes). However, AUTOMATION INFRASTRUCTURE has emerged as a CO-EQUAL binding constraint — the 48/100 automation score means every remediation action (DL-035, DL-031, registry, baselines) requires expensive manual orchestration. Improving automation would accelerate ALL remaining workstreams.
binding_constraint_reassessment.primary_constraint: Content design throughput (unchanged from S362 — same 5.6 net-new items/day, same 75 readiness plateau)
binding_constraint_reassessment.co_equal_constraint: Automation infrastructure (new finding — S365 confirmed every operational workflow requires manual invocation, creating costly friction on all remediation work)
binding_constraint_reassessment.interaction: These constraints compound: low throughput means remediation takes longer; low automation means each remediation session has higher overhead. Improving either would accelerate the other.

methodology_note: All S366 scores derived by re-evaluating S362's 6-area framework against evidence from S363/S364/S365. Areas with positive new evidence (Quality, Maturity, Administration) were re-scored upward. Areas with no new evidence (Content Production, Automation, Expansion) retained S362 scores. The FD-075 refutation removed a CRITICAL anchor dragging Quality from a plausible ~55 to 38. The DL-021 resolution removed a HIGH-severity risk and eliminated a major documentation uncertainty dragging Administration from ~65 to 58.
